data.label: SSH Session Exec
data.description: Start a one-shot listener on the SSH host

values.command:
f=$(mktemp); nohup timeout 120 python3 -c 'import socket, sys
s = socket.socket()
s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
s.listen(1)
with open(sys.argv[1], "w") as fh:
    fh.write(str(s.getsockname()[1]))
c, _ = s.accept()
s.close()
data = b""
while b"\r\n\r\n" not in data:
    chunk = c.recv(4096)
    if not chunk:
        break
    data += chunk
c.sendall(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 8\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\none-shot")
c.close()' "$f" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 100); do if [ -s "$f" ]; then cat "$f"; rm -f "$f"; exit 0; fi; sleep 0.1; done; exit 1
